moments.title: New UK Chart #1 Contender

angles.name: Chart Battle

angles.name: Dance Anthem
angles.copy: That feel-good track from HUGEL, Imael Angel & Ultra Naté is looking like a chart-topper! Get 'Movin' To The Sun' on loud!

moments.title: Scottish Freshers' Week Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Freshers' Week for many Scottish universities, including Glasgow, begins tomorrow, welcoming new students with a host of events.

angles.name: Welcome Freshers
angles.copy: Good luck to all students starting Freshers' Week across Scotland tomorrow, especially in Glasgow! Get ready for a week of new experiences.

angles.name: Advice for New Students
angles.copy: Scottish Freshers' Week starts tomorrow! Our top tip: Pace yourself, explore your new city, and make some amazing memories. What's your best Freshers' advice?

moments.title: Warehouse Project 20th Anniversary
moments.blurb: Manchester's iconic Warehouse Project opens its 20th-anniversary season on Friday with KI/KI at Depot Mayfield.

angles.name: WHP is back!
angles.copy: The legendary Warehouse Project kicks off its 20th-anniversary season this Friday! Who's ready for another incredible run at Depot Mayfield?

angles.name: Dance Season Kicks Off
angles.copy: Big news for dance fans! The Warehouse Project celebrates 20 years with its opening night this Friday. What's your favourite WHP memory?

moments.title: Niall Horan Turns 33
moments.blurb: One Direction star and solo artist Niall Horan celebrates his 33rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Niall
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to Niall Horan, who turns 33 today! What's your favourite Niall track, solo or with One Direction?

angles.name: One Direction Memories
angles.copy: It's Niall Horan's birthday! From boyband sensation to solo success, he's given us so many hits. What's your ultimate 1D anthem?

moments.title: Fiona Apple Turns 49
moments.blurb: Critically acclaimed singer-songwriter Fiona Apple celebrates her 49th birthday today.

angles.name: Fiona Apple Tribute
angles.copy: Happy 49th Birthday to the incredible Fiona Apple! A truly unique voice in music. What's your favourite of her powerful tracks?

angles.name: 90s Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of the iconic Fiona Apple today. Her music defined a generation. Which album is your go-to?

moments.title: Peter Cetera Turns 82
moments.blurb: Former Chicago frontman and solo artist Peter Cetera, known for his distinctive voice and ballads, turns 82 today.

angles.name: Voice of Chicago
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the legendary Peter Cetera! The unmistakable voice behind so many Chicago and solo hits. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Power Ballad King
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy birthday to Peter Cetera! His ballads truly hit different. Which Peter Cetera love song is on your playlist today?

moments.title: Dave Mustaine Turns 65
moments.blurb: Megadeth frontman and former Metallica guitarist Dave Mustaine celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Metal Legend
angles.copy: Raise your horns! Happy 65th Birthday to the one and only Dave Mustaine. What's your favourite Megadeth riff or lyric?

angles.name: Thrash Icon
angles.copy: A true legend of thrash metal, Dave Mustaine turns 65 today. Celebrate with us by cranking your favourite Megadeth track!

moments.title: Anastacia Turns 53

angles.name: Anastacia's Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to sing loud! Anastacia turns 53 on Thursday. What's your ultimate Anastacia power anthem?

angles.name: 00s Pop Queen
angles.copy: Throwing it back for Anastacia's birthday this week! Her vocals are still iconic. Which of her hits takes you back?

moments.title: Ricky Bell Turns 59
moments.blurb: New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe member Ricky Bell celebrates his 59th birthday on September 18.

angles.name: R&B Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 59th Birthday to Ricky Bell! From New Edition to Bell Biv DeVoe, he's given us so many classics. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Poison!
angles.copy: It's Ricky Bell's birthday this week! Get 'Poison' stuck in your head all over again to celebrate the Bell Biv DeVoe legend!

moments.title: Joanne Catherall Turns 64
moments.blurb: The Human League's iconic synth-pop vocalist Joanne Catherall celebrates her 64th birthday on September 18.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to Joanne Catherall of The Human League! A true icon of 80s synth-pop. What's your favourite track from the band?

angles.name: Don't You Want Me Baby
angles.copy: It's Joanne Catherall's birthday this Friday! Time to blast some Human League and celebrate one of the 80s' most distinctive voices.

moments.title: Nile Rodgers Turns 74
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist, songwriter, and producer Nile Rodgers of Chic celebrates his 74th birthday on September 19.

angles.name: Disco King
angles.copy: Happy 74th Birthday to the one and only Nile Rodgers! His guitar riffs are legendary. What's your favourite Chic track?

angles.name: Producer Extraordinaire
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of music mastermind Nile Rodgers this Saturday! From Chic to Bowie to Daft Punk, his influence is endless. What's your favourite Nile-produced hit?

moments.title: Autumnal Equinox Approaches
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox, marking the official start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs on September 23 at 1:06 AM BST.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Get ready for crisp leaves and pumpkin spice! The Autumnal Equinox officially marks the start of astronomical autumn this Wednesday. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Days Getting Shorter
angles.copy: The equinox is almost here, meaning days and nights are nearly equal before the nights start drawing in. Time to embrace the cosy vibes!

moments.title: Evanescence World Tour London

angles.name: Evanescence Live
angles.copy: Evanescence are at the O2 Arena in London tonight! Who's heading to see Amy Lee and the band? What song are you most hoping to hear?

angles.name: London Rocks Tonight
angles.copy: The O2 Arena is set to rock tonight as Evanescence take to the stage! If you're going, send us your pre-gig pics!
